name: rxnaija-sync
description: Sends a pharmacy's stock export to RxNaija on a schedule. Runs on the computer that holds their POS data.
//dependencies: DELIBERATELY NONE AT RUNTIME. fetch, FormData and Blob are built into Node 18+, so uploading needs no library. A pharmacy PC must never have to run npm install — and having no dependency tree is exactly what makes the single-executable build one bundle step. esbuild and postject below are BUILD tools; they ship in nothing.
//engines: Same 22.12 floor as the server, for one less version to reason about across the two.
